title: Know the paper
summary: Identify the purpose, format and timing of every reported test part without treating provisional counts as official facts.

provenance.authored_by: Codex English V3-B Sprint breadth milestone

sections.title: Separate evidence from assumption
content: List what you believe about the English paper. Label each statement official, candidate-reported or uncertain.
A remembered question count is not an official rule and should not control the study plan.

sections.title: Use the current five-part profile
content: The current report has a 90-minute Section 1 for vocabulary, banked cloze, open cloze and two reading passages, followed by a separately timed 30-minute composition.
Treat approximately 300 words as practice guidance until an official source confirms whether it is strict.

sections.title: Map format to demand
content: Vocabulary requires context and elimination; banked cloze selects from a surplus bank; open cloze generates exact words; reading locates evidence; composition plans and writes under its own clock.

sections.title: Match each task to its response
content: Classify each task as option selection, shared-bank selection, exact-word generation, passage reading or extended writing.
Write configurable instead of inventing unsupported counts.

sections.title: Build a safe paper plan
content: Create a one-page map with the two section limits, five task types and one strategy per task.
Keep the clocks separate unless official instructions allow transfer.

sections.title: Diagnose paper-knowledge errors
content: Classify mistakes as paper format, instruction control, timing control or evidence boundary before correcting the map.

sections.title: Use the reported profile accurately
content: Make five decisions about supported tasks, timing and evidence limits before viewing feedback.
